messages:
mia: I opened a docs PR to add a concise migration guide for the new rate/Quota headers. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4952

hazel: Sweet. Can we keep examples minimal: curl, python-sdk, and a node fetch? People copy-paste those.

mia: Done. Curl: `curl -H 'x-redwood-rate: premium' ...` Python: `client = Client(api_key=...)
client.request('/v1/generate', headers={'x-redwood-rate': 'premium'})` Node: `fetch(url, {headers: {'x-redwood-rate': 'premium'}})`

tom: Two quick asks: 1) call out header lowercasing because some proxies downcase headers; 2) add a short metering query so users can map tiers to billing dashboards.

anu: I added an inline tip: "use lowercase `x-redwood-rate` for widest compatibility" and a sample promql: `sum by(tier) (increase(billing.tier_assigned[7d]))` with a short plain-text explanation.

hazel: Also add a sentence clarifying Dedicated semantics: reserve capacity is consumed before burst; I fixed the wording from earlier drafts.

mia: Added a deprecation banner and a tiny migration checklist at the top: 1) Pin SDK >=0.9.2, 2) Update headers, 3) Smoke-test against staging.

docs-bot: Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-4952--docs.redwood.ai/rate-quota/migration (preview expires in 7 days).

hazel: LGTM on staging. I'll export a compact dashboard thumbnail (300x160) for the docs panel and attach in a follow-up PR.

tom: Approved from eng side. Merging in 5 unless objections.

mia: Thanks all, merging now and will follow up with dashboard image and an example of how tier changes affect cost-per-token estimates.
